source: Talos 7-11-26 SolidWorks CAD (Talos.SLDASM, configuration Default, saved suppression and visibility kept), measured with the SolidWorks 2025 API on 2026-10-30. Generated by tools/cad/build_assembly_json.py.

frame.robot_axes: robot x (forward) = CAD +Z, robot y (port/left) = CAD +X, robot z (up) = CAD +Y; origin = CAD origin, NOT the riptide base_link

total.mass_note: Sum over all resolved components, including hidden ones (e.g. the hidden ZED2i, 0.237 kg) and two duplicate foam blocks (0.856 kg). Parts with no material use SolidWorks' default 1000 kg/m^3. Cables are only partly modelled.
